summary: st-test judges a round's notes at the base commit that round fetched, not at the base ref another fetch may have moved, and says when the base moved since signing.

replay.detail: Local CI tooling only; no stored data is read or written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change. The notes are bound as before; only the run's own verdict reads the pinned base.

compatibility.detail: Same command and flags; when the base did not move, every read is the same commit as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; a base moved mid-run then reads as wrong_input or untrusted_signer again.
